Specification: This module specifies the set of possible proof-obligation states for a proof management or proof-coloring system used by the TLA+ Toolbox. It models prover status information from a constant sequence of sequences of strings, defines the space of obligation states including dummy states like "missing" and "omitted" as well as ordinary proof states, and assigns each obligation state a unique consecutive number. The specification also proves that this numbering is well-formed and injective over the set of obligation states, and then instantiates another module to use this state space and its enumeration for color predicates.
IfThenElse: IF DOMAIN f = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET i == CHOOSE v \in DOMAIN f : TRUE IN f[i] + Sum([j \in (DOMAIN f) \ {i} |-> f[j]])
IF DOMAIN f = {} THEN 1 ELSE LET i == CHOOSE v \in DOMAIN f : TRUE IN f[i] * Product([j \in (DOMAIN f) \ {i} |-> f[j]])
CaseExpr: CASE s.type = "missing" -> 0 [] s.type = "omitted" -> 1 [] s.type = "proof" -> 2 + Sum([ i \in 1..NumberOfProvers |-> ((CHOOSE j \in 1..Len(ProofStatesSpec[i]) : ProofStatesSpec[i][j] = s.status[i]) - 1) * Product([ k \in 1..(i-1) |-> Len(ProofStatesSpec[k]) ]) ])
FunctionConstructor: [ i \in 1..NumberOfProvers |-> ((CHOOSE j \in 1..Len(ProofStatesSpec[i]) : ProofStatesSpec[i][j] = s.status[i]) - 1) * Product([ k \in 1..(i-1) |-> Len(ProofStatesSpec[k]) ]) ]
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE s \in ObligationState : PrintT(s) /\ StateNumber(s) = i
